properties.name: AlexNet GPUs
properties.one_line: AlexNet trained on two GTX 580 GPUs wins ILSVRC 2012, launching the deep-learning boom

properties.name: TPU · DGX-1
properties.one_line: Google announces the Tensor Processing Unit at I/O (May 2016); Nvidia announces DGX-1 (Apr 2016)

properties.name: Volta V100
properties.one_line: Nvidia Volta V100 (May 2017) — first Tensor Cores

properties.name: Cerebras WSE
properties.one_line: Cerebras WSE-1 wafer-scale engine (Aug 2019, 1.2 trillion transistors) — specialised AI silicon returns

properties.name: Scaling laws
properties.one_line: Kaplan et al. scaling laws; compute becomes the planning variable for frontier labs (~5×/year since 2020)

properties.name: Hopper H100
properties.one_line: Nvidia Hopper architecture / H100 announced at GTC 2022, with a "transformer engine"

properties.name: Export controls
properties.one_line: US CHIPS and Science Act signed (9 Aug 2022); US export controls on advanced chips to China take effect (7 Oct 2022)

properties.name: Blackwell
properties.one_line: Nvidia Blackwell announced at GTC 2024 (18 Mar); Nvidia passes $1T (2023), $4T and $5T (2025) market capitalisation

properties.name: Ohio 8 GW
properties.one_line: Nvidia backs up to $105B in credit/compute for OpenAI's Portsmouth, Ohio data centre; SB Energy building 8 GW campus (17 Aug 2026)

properties.name: Cerebras CS-4
properties.one_line: Cerebras CS-4: 750 PFLOPS wafer-scale system, targeting 50T-parameter models, following $20B OpenAI compute partnership (19 Aug 2026)

properties.name: Jalapeño
properties.one_line: OpenAI publishes first performance results for Jalapeño, its first custom inference chip (25 Aug 2026); frontier labs join hyperscalers in building their own inference silicon

properties.name: Redwood
properties.one_line: Architect Labs Redwood: first production-worthy AI-designed accelerator, designed and verified by AI in two weeks

properties.name: Nvidia $99B · Mega-IPO
